a nickel-based corrosion resistant alloy with a nominal composition of Ni55Cr21NbxTiyMozAl0.7Fe23.5-x-y-z was designed.
The alloy ingots, with dimensions of 25 mm × 25 mm × 50 mm, were prepared using an AM-800-3 arc melting furnace.
Prior to rolling, the ingots were heated to 1100 ◦ C and held for 1.5 h, after which hot rolling was directly performed through five passes to achieve the target thickness.
The subsequent heat treatment process consisted of holding at 1050 ◦ C for 1 h, followed by water quenching.
The material was then held at 720 ◦ C for 8 h, furnace-cooled to 620 ◦ C, maintained at this temperature for another 8 h, and finally air-cooled.
